pull_request.body:
This unsigned outline prototype implements the updated [inward-inter-coil sketch and middle-station offset](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6290378667), following the refined endcap wheels and outer-barrel stagger. **B1 coil-plane facets remain at 5.20 m; inter-coil facets move inward to 4.63 m and widen to 1.552830 m. B2 rotates 7.5 degrees and is freshly packed around fixed hardware.** The new total is 936 chambers: B1/B2/B3=96/216/432 plus 192 unchanged endcaps, with 15 barrel dimension families versus 13. The 48 extra chambers are B2 hardware cuts; no count reduction is claimed.

![Actual before/after chamber sections](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/views/barrel-cross-sections.png)

- [Blue chambers / grey coils OBJ+MTL ZIP](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/raw/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/obj/chambers-and-coils.zip)
- [Separate barrel, positive-endcap and toroids/frame components](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/raw/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/obj/components.zip)
- [Longitudinal source footprints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/views/longitudinal-packing.png)
- [Dimension inventory](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/inventory/after-barrel.md)
- [Current report and independent assessment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/ec575d2e41e95e6b3ba059932a222fc1ac379b62/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/README.md)

The 500 mm-deep B1 templates give0.1 degree full-depth angular overlap with the 30 mm border, while the actual neighboring prisms remain35.33094 mm apart (20 mm required). R 4.63 lies in a narrow sufficient interval4.625–4.645247 m, with 140.54 mm conservative installed-HCAL margin and 55 mm above the known DES034 ECAL water-jacket reservation. That service reservation is not installed HCAL material or certification of complete external HCAL routes; collectors/cables/plant remain unimplemented/unqualified. Complete source/service inequalities and actual finite-HCAL checks are retained.

“Half a sector” is 7.5 degrees for the 24-facet barrel;15 degrees would realign its nominal edges. The user has confirmed that the middle-station rotation applies to **B2 barrel only**, matching the implemented candidate. Endcap wheels retain their192 value-identical outlines; rotating them through fixed coil slots would require separate repacking. B3 and 484 frame objects are also unchanged. Actual B2 rotation needs finite ECT/spoke/lug exclusions in every facet; all 312 changed panels receive fresh 50 mm coil/frame certificates and actual-orientation audits. All 437,580 chamber pairs and 24 B1 neighbor tests pass. Nine focused tests include deterministic/adverse controls.

A new 65,536 iid full 4π straight-direction bank, seed40088, requires both depth faces in one cassette and three distinct station IDs. Three-station availability is 66.0767%→67.4057% outline, or57.7698%→59.0866% with 30 mm border. Border gains/losses are5,608/4,745: net+1.316833 percentage points, paired Monte Carlo SE0.155174 points. At least two bordered stations rises80.6076%→88.4827%. B2 rotation alone reduces the strict three-station proxy; component controls and loss masks are reported. The combined result is a net gain with substantial local losses, not pointwise improvement. All fractions are geometric, with no material veto, response or reconstructed efficiency.

All 1,024 zero-field native ACTS tracks complete and match independent finite-prism station masks, including30 mm borders. The 256-track unchanged-map smoke retains 197 completed and 59 field-masked rows in denominators. It is a bounded navigation check, not a new broad momentum-performance scan. Actual same-ray chord/spacing distributions, including the common before/after cohort, replace any assumption of constant lever arm; no MDT momentum-resolution claim is made.

All magnetic sources/maps and their4.598715883 GJ joint vacuum-field solution are unchanged; no magnetic recalculation is needed. Maximum chamber radius stays9.099797510 m within the 9.1 m numerical chamber world and 9.5 m map; frame/feet extend outside that vacuum navigation volume. All 709 prior scoped scientific source/evidence files remain byte-exact. Installed nonlinear iron/conductor/cryostat, chamber internals/sag/alignment and complete services remain open. **Uniform middle-wheel eta3 remains UNMET** from fixed ECT inner legs. DES039/DES040 remain DRAFT, with no human engineering acceptance or production integration; stacked on unmerged PR87.

Source freeze65cf2741bd697ddb8c4022a751f275b41f63241e; exact artifact review target11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6. [Separate PhysVal review](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/ec575d2e41e95e6b3ba059932a222fc1ac379b62/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/review/physics-review.md).

Historical controls remain available: [previous888 barrel-overlap candidate](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b34bb375524bb1e8591e9a5adf9c2c0b3d1d8ab0/docs/validation/DES-040/barrel-overlap-2026-10-20/README.md), [refined endcap aperture/spacing assessment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/96c61b29cb8ae25817c88304915dd766c418883d/docs/validation/DES-040/refined-wheels-2026-10-20/README.md), and [blocked coil-plane-under-BT proposal/unselected outward trial](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6c8ecbe4a846f4affd654e832eb93edb35410eff/docs/validation/DES-040/inner-barrel-2026-10-20/README.md). The new inward inter-coil936 candidate is distinct from that older unselected outward936 trial.

Token accounting is updated for the closed PR90 work: **41 distinct turns / 251,014,811 observed tokens**, comprising 39 design/validation/delivery turns and two accounting-review turns. All ten original task journals are backfilled; duplicate ownership and prior PR86/87 usage are excluded. The current active closeout parent turn remains uncounted. [Accounting report and exact subtotals](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/db88f594ab29a2a509b4308fdfddf14ffe5f822e/logs/usage/PR90-2026-10-20.md), [final machine-readable summary](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/db88f594ab29a2a509b4308fdfddf14ffe5f822e/logs/usage/PR90-2026-10-20-final-summary.json), and [independent first-import accounting assessment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/db88f594ab29a2a509b4308fdfddf14ffe5f822e/logs/usage/pr90-review/accounting-review.md). Logger, project/workflow validation and token dashboard validation/build pass locally; the project dashboard now contains 251 dated observations / 875,314,216 observed tokens. These are partial client observations, not a billing total. Geometry, magnetic maps and scientific evidence remain unchanged by this accounting closeout.

Great comment!

Let me specify:
- there exists now a minimum momentum requirement for muons to be detected
- there exists a magnetic field map
- there exists a prototype chamber layout
- With the ACTS toolkit, we could now create an ACTS field map representing the field 
- A very simplified tracking geometry with the chambers placed in the muon volume 
- assuming the in-out surfaces of the chambers counting as a future MDT multi-layer each large chamber surface (not the side surfaces) hit can be regarded as a segment 
- That would allow to make a coverage test using ACTS with realistic field and realistic chamber coverage, and we could see if in min_momentum to 1 TeV we have a relatively consistent coverage of >5 segements throughout 
 
A representative phi-eta hit coverage map at the entrance cylinder of the muon spectrometer would be convincing for low / mid / ultimate muon momenta.

Addressed the ACTS requests in [the frozen study](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b33403ac7476fd8392542d28f984a426660527b3/docs/validation/DES-040/acts-propagation/results.md): actual finite chamber TrackingGeometry, strict joint-field provider, recorded native boundary positions, XY/RZ views, and charge-separated entrance phi/eta maps at 2.65 GeV, 100 GeV and 1 TeV. The full scan also includes 5 and 10 GeV. Only the large faces count; side events and same-chamber three-station pairing are retained separately.

The answer to consistent >5 coverage is **no for the current fixed layout over 4π**: six-face proven fractions are 39–44%, and even assigning all unfinished field-mask cases a pass only gives 77–80%. The unknowns are shown explicitly and remain in denominators. This is local entrance momentum and a vacuum surface audit, with no scattering/eloss/response or reconstructed-efficiency claim. Geometry and field inputs are unchanged.

The requested dependency rebuild is complete (385 ACTS C++ tests, three integration suites, 28 Python passes/two optional skips). Native field/geometry/analytic/refinement controls and 81 repository science tests pass. [Final independent review](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/c2ab8ffe6aa16a71e8d0a0a90b173c20d523d7b0/docs/validation/DES-040/acts-propagation/review.md) records the corrected findings and remaining limits.

What is the reason why the inner ring sectors do not close up ?
- Can we achieve that ?

The extra fan-shaped gaps can be reduced. Complete closure at the twelve barrel-toroid legs is impossible with the magnets fixed: each 0.50 × 0.60 m warm envelope crosses the full 500 mm chamber depth, with a further 50 mm clearance reservation. The current single trapezoid per sector spreads this local exclusion into long wedges; it is a real geometry effect.

I added a [checked segmentation study](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/ae9141d95136cc20f853bbe3b234f5b1a8b5c634/docs/validation/DES-040/inner-closure-2026-10-20/README.md):

- **Two radial bands:** 24 trapezoids per end, with narrow seams in the inner band and coil slots in the outer band. Planar missing area falls from **31.17% to 15.50%**. Full-depth, same-chamber straight-IP-ray loss falls from **30.15% to 19.17%**, or **34.89% to 25.38%** with the 30 mm border proxy.
- **Three bands:** the outer rim closes further in XY, but its 0.411 m span violates the 0.50 m minimum, and extra radial seams worsen the full-depth ray loss to 27.97%. This is retained only as a diagnostic.

![Current and optional inner-wheel segmentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/0d7a815fc299c971be1c6af3911c50e9f0a9b585/docs/validation/DES-040/inner-closure-2026-10-20/inner-closure-comparison.png)

Total endcap shape families would increase from 8 to 9. Independent calculation/figure assessment is included. **The middle-wheel eta=3 requirement remains physically blocked.** At its near face, the eta=3 circle passes through actual ECT warm inner legs for every phi. The three simple families therefore need larger actual bores, giving sector-centre limits eta≈2.91079/2.85668. I have not labelled this as achieved eta=3 coverage. Meeting that requirement needs a change to the physical magnet/station layout.

For the placement question: the inner wheel is before ECT but within the BT leg length; the middle is inside both toroid regions; the outer is beyond both. Moving the middle beyond both needs zcentre>=12.35 m, where it conflicts with the rear frame and outer wheel. Clearing the frame and keeping 20 mm between wheels would push the outer centre beyond 13.27 m. Keeping the outer fixed instead sharply reduces the three-point bending-distance factor. The report gives the calculation; it is not a momentum-resolution prediction.

There are **1,248 total outlines and seven endcap shape families**. This remains a DRAFT outline prototype without chamber internals or engineering acceptance.

- Increasing the provisional maximum z seed from 2 m to 4 m, with freshly certified seam merges, reduces barrels **1,056 → 696** (96/168/432), or 34.1%. The 192 endcaps are identical, giving 888 total outlines. Actual maximum lengths are 3.208/3.664/3.554 m. The tradeoff is **13 barrel size families versus 7**, including narrow hardware fragments; chamber internals and long-tube engineering remain open.

I checked the inward stagger against the actual HCAL solids. **The 500 mm-deep coil-plane chambers cannot fit below the present BT inner legs.**

The BT warm inner face is at 4.35 m; retaining 50 mm coil clearance requires chamber apothem **R≤4.05 m**. The actual finite HCAL rear cover requires **R≥4.458–4.53025 m** with the same HCAL clearance and retained width. All 48 moved coil-plane chambers intersect HCAL steel/cover. For example, `(4.12,0,1)m` is inside both a moved chamber and a finite steel plate. The check uses the real 16-sector geometry, not a filled corner-radius circle.

events.text:
This unsigned outline prototype implements the updated [inward-inter-coil sketch and middle-station offset](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6290378667), following the refined endcap wheels and outer-barrel stagger. **B1 coil-plane facets remain at 5.20 m; inter-coil facets move inward to 4.63 m and widen to 1.552830 m. B2 rotates 7.5 degrees and is freshly packed around fixed hardware.** The new total is 936 chambers: B1/B2/B3=96/216/432 plus 192 unchanged endcaps, with 15 barrel dimension families versus 13. The 48 extra chambers are B2 hardware cuts; no count reduction is claimed.

![Actual before/after chamber sections](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/views/barrel-cross-sections.png)

- [Blue chambers / grey coils OBJ+MTL ZIP](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/raw/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/obj/chambers-and-coils.zip)
- [Separate barrel, positive-endcap and toroids/frame components](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/raw/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/obj/components.zip)
- [Longitudinal source footprints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/views/longitudinal-packing.png)
- [Dimension inventory](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/11ec9bb670bca2b882929d1d2b4ef7d9da534da6/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/inventory/after-barrel.md)
- [Current report and independent assessment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/ec575d2e41e95e6b3ba059932a222fc1ac379b62/docs/validation/DES-040/sketched-stagger-2026-10-20/README.md)

The 500 mm-deep B1 templates give0.1 degree full-depth angular overlap with the 30 mm border, while the actual neighboring prisms remain35.33094 mm apart (20 mm required). R 4.63 lies in a narrow sufficient interval4.625–4.645247 m, with 140.54 mm conservative installed-HCAL margin and 55 mm above the known DES034 ECAL water-jacket reservation. That service reservation is not installed HCAL material or certification of complete external HCAL routes; collectors/cables/plant remain unimplemented/unqualified. Complete source/service inequalities and actual finite-HCAL checks are retained.

“Half a sector” is 7.5 degrees for the 24-facet barrel;15 degrees would realign its nominal edges. The user has confirmed that the middle-station rotation applies to **B2 barrel only**, matching the implemented candidate. Endcap wheels retain their192 value-identical outlines; rotating them through fixed coil slots would require separate repacking. B3 and 484 frame objects are also unchanged. Actual B2 rotation needs finite ECT/spoke/lug exclusions in every facet; all 312 changed panels receive fresh 50 mm coil/frame certificates and actual-orientation audits. All 437,580 chamber pairs and 24 B1 neighbor tests pass. Nine focused tests include deterministic/adverse controls.

A new 65,536 iid full 4π straight-direction bank, seed40088, requires both depth faces in one cassette and three distinct station IDs. Three-station availability is 66.0767%→67.4057% outline, or57.7698%→59.0866% with 30 mm border. Border gains/losses are5,608/4,745: net+1.316833 percentage points, paired Monte Carlo SE0.155174 points. At least two bordered stations rises80.6076%→88.4827%. B2 rotation alone reduces the strict three-station proxy; component controls and loss masks are reported. The combined result is a net gain with substantial local losses, not pointwise improvement. All fractions are geometric, with no material veto, response or reconstructed efficiency.

All 1,024 zero-field native ACTS tracks complete and match independent finite-prism station masks, including30 mm borders. The 256-track unchanged-map smoke retains 197 completed and 59 field-masked rows in denominators. It is a bounded navigation check, not a new broad momentum-performance scan. Actual same-ray chord/spacing distributions, including the common before/after cohort, replace any assumption of constant lever arm; no MDT momentum-resolution claim is made.

All magnetic sources/maps and their4.598715883 GJ joint vacuum-field solution are unchanged; no magnetic recalculation is needed. Maximum chamber radius stays9.099797510 m within the 9.1 m numerical chamber world and 9.5 m map; frame/feet extend outside that vacuum navigation volume. All 709 prior scoped scientific source/evidence files remain byte-exact. Installed nonlinear iron/conductor/cryostat, chamber internals/sag/alignment and complete services remain open. **Uniform middle-wheel eta3 remains UNMET** from fixed ECT inner legs. DES039/DES040 remain DRAFT, with no human engineering acceptance or production integration; stacked on unmerged PR87.

Executed from `[redacted]`:

```sh
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import copy,json,numpy as np
from tools.muon_layout import barrel_overlap as b, geometry as g
c=json.loads(b.DEFAULT_CONFIG.read_text());base=json.load(open(b.ROOT/c['base_geometry']))
rng=np.random.default_rng(40090);n=16384
mu=rng.uniform(-np.tanh(1),np.tanh(1),n);phi=rng.uniform(0,2*np.pi,n)
d=np.column_stack((np.sqrt(1-mu**2)*np.cos(phi),np.sqrt(1-mu**2)*np.sin(phi),mu))
result={}
for length in (3.,6.):
 config=copy.deepcopy(c);config['max_barrel_length_m']=length
 geo,ct=b.build(base,config);out={}
 for border in (0,.03):
  hits=np.zeros((n,3),bool)
  for p in geo['panels']:
   if p['kind']=='barrel':
    ix=np.flatnonzero(~hits[:,p['station']-1]);hits[ix,p['station']-1]|=np.isfinite(g.midplane_hits(p,d[ix],border,True))
  out[str(border)]=dict(station_fractions=hits.mean(axis=0).tolist(),three_station_fraction=float(hits.all(axis=1).mean()))
 result[str(length)]=dict(counts=ct['counts'],size_report=ct['dimensions_after'],packing=ct['max_z_seam_merging'],quick_geometry=out)
 b.save('/private/tmp/pr90-BO-M1-seed'+str(int(length))+'-geometry.json',geo)
 b.save('/private/tmp/pr90-BO-M1-seed'+str(int(length))+'-controls.json',ct)
 print(json.dumps(dict(seed_length_m=length,barrel_count=ct['barrel_count_after'],counts=ct['counts']['barrel'],families={j:v['dimension_family_count'] for j,v in ct['dimensions_after'].items()},quick_geometry=out)),flush=True)
b.save('/private/tmp/pr90-BO-M1-seed-diagnostics.json',result)
PY
```

**Signed μ**, independently sampled across both ends; no mirroring. One shared direction bank serves both seed lengths and borders. Here μ=cosθ=tanhη, so sampling is equal solid angle conditional on |η|<1.

The observable unions same-cassette full-depth barrel hits within each station, then requires all three stations. Every denominator is 16,384. No endcaps, coil/support ray veto or transport enter this diagnostic.
